messages:
tara: Security scan flagged a vuln in backup-agent: a race where streaming multipart uploads can complete before client sets SSE-KMS headers. Objects land unencrypted briefly.
ben: :grimacing: Is this local-only or can it hit prod snapshots?
tara: Repro on staging, and we saw one prod snapshot attempt that matched the fingerprint (same agent sha). Not complete yet but risk of cleartext landing if the timing lines up.
zia: How does the agent handle part commits? Does it set metadata only at final copy?
tara: It relies on the client to set `x-amz-server-side-encryption` on the final PUT. In multipart flow the parts were committed, then finalization RPC failed to include headers in the presign policy.
platform: deploy-bot: detected agent version 2.4.3 deployed to eu-central-1 yesterday.
kms-ops-bot: Incident created: ENC-VULN-2026-211. Severity: high (potential transient cleartext at rest). Suggested actions: immediate mitigation, audit sweep, re-encrypt if needed.
ben: Immediate triage: 1) roll back agent to 2.4.2 in prod-canary and pause further rollouts. 2) block presign endpoint for multipart flows. 3) run object metadata scan for recent `/snapshots/` uploads missing SSE.
tara: Agreed. Also add a temporary S3 bucket policy requiring `x-amz-server-side-encryption` header on PutObject for snapshot-prefix. That blocks any new unsafe uploads at the store layer. Example snippet: 
`{"Condition":{"Null":{"aws:RequestHeader/x-amz-server-side-encryption":"false"}},"Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":"s3:PutObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-snapshots/*"}`
zia: Good call. For existing objects, can we detect timestamp window and rewrap?
ben: Plan: detection job lists objects with missing SSE and last-modified in the vulnerable window. If count small, copy->rewrite with SSE-KMS under uploader principal AFTER generating ephemeral KMS grants for target CMKs. If large, freeze snapshot ingestion and coordinate tenant owners.
tara: Encryption context check: our decrypt flow requires context `{tenant_id, snapshot_id}`. Rewrap must call Encrypt with same context. We'll need to pass snapshot metadata to the rewrap job.
kms-ops-bot: Note: ephemeral grants recommended. Do NOT add broad key policy edits without customer approval. Grants example CLI: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <key> --grantee-principal <arn> --operations Encrypt Decrypt --grant-tokens <token>`
zia: Audit logging: we need to capture who issued the presign, which agent instance performed the multipart, client IPs, and the final PutObject headers (if any). CloudTrail plus our uploader proxy logs should cover it, but add a SIEM rule to correlate PutObject -> object metadata mismatch.
ben: Also add a historical evidence export for compliance: list of affected objects, tenants, attempted restores, CloudTrail events. Tagging for legal/compliance review.
tara: Vuln triage: mark as security bug, create PR to add unit/integration tests that simulate multipart finalization and ensure presign includes SSE conditions. Add deploy-gate preventing presign code changes without test.
zia: Quick patch idea: change presign generator to embed required headers in signed conditions for multipart completes, and have the upload-proxy verify finalization headers match conditions.
ben: Post-mortem actions: - Harden presign policies for single-part and multipart flows. - Add S3 bucket-level enforcement for snapshot prefixes as defense-in-depth. - Automate ephemeral grant creation for rewrap jobs. - Add CI check for role-to-key mapping drift.
tara: Any decision on CMK rotation? Rotating keys is heavy and breaks older snapshots. Not preferred unless we detect exfil or confirmed cleartext exposure.
zia: Agreed. Only rotate if we find objects that were actually exposed and not rewrapped. Otherwise rewrap + audit + policy fixes.
platform: infra note: we'll push a hotfix to uploader-proxy to validate presign conditions and then rollback agent. Also scheduling a maintenance window to run rewrap queue for small sets.
ben: Who owns the rewrap? tara volunteers for detection and small rewraps; infra to provide ephemeral grant automation.
tara: I'll open the security PR and attach repro steps and a short runbook for oncall.
kms-ops-bot: Update: mitigations applied in eu-central-1: presign multipart disabled, bucket policy enforced, detection job scheduled. Monitoring enabled.
ben: Keep the channel updated with detection counts and any tenant escalations.
tara: Will do. Attaching one log snippet for reference: `PUT /snapshots/tenant-12/snap-2026-03-12.part-3 200 - headers: {"Content-Length": 5242880}` (no SSE header).
zia: Good capture. That will help SIEM rule.
ben: :thumbsup:
